view: Frontal (PA/AP) upright chest radiograph, NIH-style cropped field of view
technical_quality: Adequate. Minimal rotation (spinous processes roughly midway between clavicular heads), moderate inspiration with domed hemidiaphragms at approximately the 8th-9th posterior ribs, lung apices and both costophrenic angles included, lower chest/upper abdomen partly cropped. Penetration adequate with thoracic spine visible through the cardiac silhouette. Slight blurring of bronchovascular detail from the large body habitus.

devices.type: external side/orientation marker (small chevron-shaped radiopaque marker)
devices.location: upper corner of the image over the patient's left shoulder soft tissue, outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Coarse, increased bronchovascular / reticular markings in the medial right lower zone adjacent to the right hilum and right heart border, suggesting a mild interstitial/peribronchial infiltrate; no consolidation with air bronchogram, no cavitation
Mildly prominent hila with accentuated peribronchovascular markings bilaterally, greater on the right
Borderline enlarged cardiac silhouette (cardiothoracic ratio approximately 0.53-0.55) with leftward-projecting left ventricular contour
Prominent aortic knob and unfolded/tortuous thoracic aorta, consistent with age-related aortic ectasia
Degenerative changes of both glenohumeral joints (joint space narrowing, sclerosis, osteophytosis) and diffuse osteopenia
Degenerative changes of the thoracic spine with mild scoliosis/kyphosis

description_zh: 胸部正面X光片，吸氣量尚可，無明顯旋轉。右下肺野內側靠近右肺門及右心緣處可見支氣管血管紋理增粗、呈網狀增加，疑為輕度間質性/支氣管周圍浸潤，未見實質化、空洞或肋膜積液，雙側肋橫膈角銳利。心臟輪廓略偏大（心胸比約0.53-0.55），主動脈弓突出且胸主動脈迂曲，符合老年性主動脈擴張；未見任何導管、引流管或心律調節器。雙側肩關節及胸椎呈退化性變化，骨質疏鬆，未見明顯肋骨骨折。
